notes.title: BLOODY HELL 2 Revealed!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010150/BLOODY_HELL_2/

[h2]🩸BLOODY HELL 2 IS OFFICIAL![/h2]
[h2]Wishlist the game to support the development![/h2]

Pulverize demons as a small Angel wielding a [b]GIANT DEMONIC HAMMER![/b]
Explore Hell's deepest layers, and uncover the truth of how Heaven fell in this [b]BULLET-HELL METROIDVANIA! [/b]
Will you succeed, or die in the chaotic depths of [b]BLOODY HELL 2?[/b]

We will be posting update posts on our [url=https://discord.gg/ZjNyTRvqQR]Discord community server[/url] and on our [url=https://x.com/BloodyHellGame]Twitter account[/url].🕊️

notes.title: February 3rd bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed bug that caused blackscreen when returning to menu
- Fixed bug that caused blackscreen when returning from credits
- Fixed bug that caused Charge Laser to not pierce through objects
- Fixed bug that caused Charge Laser to not pierce through player's shield
- Fixed bug that caused Ladders to not behave properly
- Fixed bug that caused the Chicken Mom to not have correct dialog
- Fixed bug that caused the Vulture to push other enemies into walls

notes.title: January 30th bug fixes
notes.content:
- Added V-sync option
- Added Discord Rich Presence
- Fixed bug that caused "last secret upgrade" to not appear
- Fixed issue with vulture bouncing on chickens
- Fixed issue with certain holes that you could walk on
- Fixed other small problems

notes.title: Day 1 bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the bones couldn't be picked up anymore
- Fixed an issue with the "secret final upgrade" breaking heaven's shops
- Fixed Minecart sounds
- Fixed an issue with one of the earlier doors
- Fixed an issue with an invisible enemy in the last zone
